JOPED (formerly Journal of Occupational Psychology, Employment and Disability) is a DWP journal for practitioners, academics, policy makers and other professionals working in the area of health and work.

Copies of the latest articles from JOPED can be obtained from the DWP publications archive.

Email the title and reference number of the publication you need to: library.archive@dwp.gov.uk
